column2: Website passwords you import are stored in the same encrypted database, and password fields are additionally encrypted one by one with the app's cipher suite; system verification (biometrics or screen lock) is required before viewing or copying a password. Passwords are currently not uploaded, synced or written to backups.

column1: 检查与下载更新：在你主动检查更新（或开启自动检查）时，应用会访问 GitHub 获取版本信息；下载安装包时可能经由 GitHub 加速镜像（如 ghfast.top、gh-proxy.com 等），这些镜像可看到你的 IP 地址与下载地址。
